summary_en: Keiyo Bank will acquire additional shares in two subsidiaries, Keiyo Bank Card and Keiyo Bank Guarantee Service, to achieve full ownership. The acquisition aims to strengthen group governance and enable efficient integrated management in response to changing customer needs driven by demographic shifts and digitalization. Shares will be acquired from current shareholders by end of fiscal year 2026 through mutual agreement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Full Acquisition of Subsidiary Shares Through Additional Stock Purchase
translation_en_brief:
Keiyo Bank announced on September 30, 2026 that its Board of Directors has approved the acquisition of additional shares in two consolidated subsidiaries: Keiyo Bank Card Co., Ltd. and Keiyo Bank Guarantee Service Co., Ltd., to achieve full ownership of both entities.

The bank currently holds 5.26% directly in Keiyo Bank Card and 36.84% indirectly through Keiyo Bank Guarantee Service. The other significant shareholder is Fujimi Tochi Co., Ltd., which holds 36.84% of Keiyo Bank Card. The specific purchase price, number of shares to be acquired, and detailed transaction terms are not disclosed in this announcement.

The acquisition is motivated by the need to strengthen group governance and enable swift, efficient integrated management of the group as a whole. This is in response to changing business environments characterized by demographic decline, digitalization, and cashless payment trends, which have made customer needs increasingly diverse and complex. The bank plans to acquire the shares through mutual agreement with current shareholders by the end of fiscal year 2026.
